node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 exact active-allocation inequality
node.statement: In the active KoalaBear m2 r4 first-match manifest, print the exact integers U_positive, U_sourcecover, U_K3=U_positive+U_sourcecover, and U_K3_allocation, bind each input to its proof certificate and manifest digest, and prove by exact integer arithmetic that U_K3 does not exceed U_K3_allocation. No floating-point comparison, owner renormalization, omitted line multiplicity, or allocation imported from a different row or partition is allowed.
node.falsifier: The exact total exceeds the allocation, an input integer lacks a pinned proof certificate, a digest or row differs, or the comparison uses a different owner/normalization convention.
